Lead-to-Cash stages 1–2: Capture & Qualify

AI agents for your inbound leads and prospects

Every website form, social media lead, chat and email inquiry is taken in, checked, enriched and answered in minutes, day or night. Your AI agents ask the questions your team would ask, keep your CRM clean, and book the next step or alert the right person.

Book a Free Consultation See how it works

Leads don't wait

Most prospects hire whoever responds first. These are the places growing businesses lose them.

Slow first response

A quote request sits until someone has time, and the prospect has already contacted two other companies.

After hours and weekends

Inquiries that arrive at night or on Saturday wait until someone is back in the office.

Buried in the inbox

Form emails, social media leads and chat messages pile up in shared inboxes, and some never get answered.

A messy CRM

Duplicates, missing phone numbers and typos mean your team chases bad data and can't see which marketing works.

What your AI agents handle

Set up around your services, your questions and your rules, not a generic script.

Takes in every lead source

Website forms, chat, email and social media lead ads arrive in one place with the source tracked, so nothing waits in an inbox.

Cleans up each lead

Names, phone numbers and addresses are standardized and checked against existing customers, so your CRM stays free of duplicates and typos.

Checks before anything goes out

A second agent reviews each lead and each reply for missing details and risky wording. Anything uncertain goes to a person.

Adds what your team needs

Confirms the address and service area and adds the job details and answers to your questions, so the lead is ready to quote.

Responds in minutes

Sends a personal reply by email or chat in your voice, asks your qualifying questions, and follows up if the prospect goes quiet.

Books or routes the next step

Books the appointment on your calendar, or alerts the right person by email or chat with everything they need to follow up.

How it works

From first inquiry to a qualified lead in your CRM, without anyone stopping what they're doing.

  1. Step 1

    An inquiry arrives

    A website form, chat message, email or social media lead.

  2. Step 2

    Intake and clean-up

    The agent reads it, standardizes the details and checks for duplicates.

  3. Step 3

    Quality check

    A second agent reviews it and flags anything unclear for your team.

  4. Step 4

    Enrich and respond

    The lead is completed, the prospect gets a personal reply, and your questions are asked.

  5. Step 5

    The next step happens

    An appointment is booked, a quote is started, or your team is alerted.

You stay in control

  • Your rules, your voice. You approve what the agents say, which questions they ask and what they should never promise.
  • A person whenever it's needed. Prospects can ask for a human, and urgent or unusual requests go straight to your team.
  • Approval settings. Review replies before they go out, or approve only the exceptions once you trust the results.
  • Everything is reviewable. Every lead, reply and decision is logged, so you can check quality and coach the agents over time.
  • Your accounts, your data. Built on accounts in your name and documented, so you're never locked in.

Works with what you already use

  • Your CRM (Jobber, The Customer Factor, Housecall Pro, etc.)
  • Website forms
  • Social media lead ads
  • Shared email inbox
  • Calendar & scheduling
  • Website chat

A good fit for

Home services and trades, professional services, medical and dental offices, real estate, and other local businesses that depend on inbound inquiries and quote requests.

Getting started

Most clients start with one lead source, such as the website quote form, and run it side by side with their team before going live. See how engagements work.

Will prospects know they're talking to AI?

We recommend being upfront. Replies come from your business, and a prospect can ask for a person at any time. You choose the wording.

What happens when the AI isn't sure?

It does what a careful assistant would: holds the reply, flags the lead for your team, and tells them exactly what's missing. Nothing uncertain is sent on its own.

Do I need a new CRM or new forms?

Usually not. We connect to the CRM, website forms, email and calendar you already use. If something is missing, we recommend an option that fits your size and budget.

What does it cost?

After the free consultation, you get a fixed price for the pilot. Ongoing software and AI usage is billed by those providers directly to accounts in your name, and we estimate it for you up front, so there are no surprises.

How quickly can it be running?

A pilot on one lead source, such as your website quote form, typically runs within a few weeks. It runs side by side with your team before it goes live with customers.
